data.description:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

Role Summary 

The Pursuit Lead, Elevate owns transformational opportunities end-to-end—from first strategic engagement through close and into early customer success. You are the single point of accountability for deal progression, commercial architecture, and customer outcomes. Unlike traditional deal roles, you work shoulder-to-shoulder with an embedded Transformational Platform Consultant; you own the transformation strategy and commercial model while they own the technical transformation narrative and North Star architecture. Together, you present one unified voice, one coherent vision, and one executable path to operational transformation through the ServiceNow platform. 

You operate upstream of traditional sales motions, identifying and developing transformational opportunities that cut across business units and require platform-level thinking, executive engagement, and cross-functional orchestration from our ecosystem and partners.

Six Core Accountabilities 

Own Deal Outcome & Business Impact 

Drive the complete deal lifecycle as the business strategist and executive deal leader. Own the strategic hypothesis for transformation from initial customer vision all the way through to value driving deal shaping, commercial architecture, and handoff into post-sale. Ensure the deal structure, investment thesis, and success metrics align with the customer's bold transformation ambition, not just a software purchase. 

Shape Transformational Hypotheses Using Platform Depth 

Partner with the Transformational Platform Consultant to connect customer business imperatives to the ServiceNow platform as a unified operational backbone. Develop a North Star vision that shows how NOW enables measurable outcomes—faster decision cycles, reduced operational friction, AI-accelerated operations, or enterprise-wide visibility. Make the platform's operational impact tangible and urgent, not abstract. 

Orchestrate Cross-Functional Pursuit Execution 

Act as the single point of accountability for deal momentum. Mobilize Partners, Value teams, GTM, Enterprise Architecture, Hyperscalers, Finance, Legal, Revenue, etc into one unified pursuit with clear ownership. Remove blockers, escalate conflicts, redirect resources, and maintain tempo. Silo'd work isn't allowed—every function moves the deal forward together or not at all. 

Build Commercial Models That Unlock Transformational Investment 

Challenge assumptions about what transformational deals can look like. Invent new commercial structures (outcome agreements, platform commitments, co-investment models, pricing ramps) that align customer risk with platform value realization. Own the deal economics—not just revenue, but deal shape, investment strategy, and commercial terms that reflect transformation scope. 

Create Executive Conviction Through Outcome Clarity 

Craft C-suite narratives that connect business imperatives to platform capabilities to measurable operational outcomes. Move customers from curiosity → confidence → commitment by simplifying complexity and making the transformation case irrefutable. Work alongside the Transformational Platform Consultant to speak both business and technical languages with credibility. 

Codify and Raise the Bar for Future Pursuits 

Every deal teaches. Capture what worked—use-case patterns, commercial structures, stakeholder plays, objection patterns, sequencing. Mine deal stalls for pattern insights. Feed playbook learnings back into Elevate strategy teams. Mentor peers on pursuit mastery. Redefine how ServiceNow pursues transformational business with each win. 

Lifecycle Ownership: S0–S5+ 

Sense Intent & Shape Opportunity (S0–S1) 

  • Identify transformation signals: Where is the customer facing structural business change (market shift, operating model redesign, AI adoption cliff, loss of strategic capability)? 

  • Conduct deep strategic discovery with C-suite and board: Uncover business imperatives, organizational constraints, transformation timelines, and success metrics. 

  • Partner with Portfolio Intelligence to form transformation readiness hypothesis and identify the right NOW capabilities. 

  • Co-create the opening vision with the Transformational Platform Consultant: Position this as a transformational moment where NOW becomes the operational backbone, not a software conversation. 

  • Sequence ecosystem partners (Product, Inspire, GTM, Enterprise Architecture) into a deliberate strategy before pursuit begins. 

Co-Create & Architect (S2–S3) 

  • Validate the North Star: Work with the Transformational Platform Consultant to stress-test the platform vision against customer architecture, integration needs, and operating model. 

  • Build executive conviction: Craft C-level narratives showing how NOW solves their boldest imperative. Make the business case undeniable. 

  • Design commercial architecture: Invent deal structures (outcome agreements, platform commitments, phased investment, shared risk) that reward transformation outcomes. 

  • Orchestrate cross-functional alignment: Ensure Partners, Enterprise Architecture, Finance, Legal, and Revenue are aligned on pursuit strategy and customer commitments. 

  • Maintain stakeholder momentum: Lock in customer commitment to sequencing, investment timeline, and success metrics. 

Drive Commercial & Close (S4–S5) 

  • Lead final negotiations: Finalize commercial terms, investment structure, and customer commitments. 

  • Maintain executive engagement: Keep deal momentum through decision cycles by reinforcing strategic messaging and outcomes. 

  • Coordinate internal execution: Align approvals, financing, Legal, and ecosystem delivery sequencing. 

  • Ensure commercial integrity: Validate that deal terms, platform scope, and success metrics all ladder to the transformation thesis. 

Secure & Embed Value (S5–S5+) 

  • Own the handoff to Account Owner, Customer Success, and Delivery teams: Ensure transformation thesis, platform roadmap, commercial model, and success metrics are understood and locked in. 

  • Monitor early value realization: Track customer's time-to-value, adoption, outcome realization. Identify and remove blockers. 

  • Identify adjacent opportunities: Spot expansion use cases and renewal growth as customer scales transformation. 

  • Capture and codify learnings: Document use-case patterns, commercial structures, stakeholder plays, deal stalls, and success factors. Share playbook insights with team. 

Qualifications

Required 

  • 10+ years of traditional enterprise sales, Software Sales and deal structuring 

  • 5+ years of Large Deal Pursuit type role with proven track record closing $50M+ TCV contracts with a focus on incremental revenue vs renewals 

  • And/or 5+ years of experience with corporate strategy, business development, large, complex corporate transactions (M&A, IP acquisition, revenue-share models, strategic partnerships, or consulting engagements) 

  • Demonstrated executive presence: Credible with C-suite stakeholders in strategic business conversations, not just sales pitches 

  • Deep understanding of enterprise transformation: Know how operating models change, what drives customer urgency, and how to sequence multi-year transformation programs 

  • Ability to influence without authority: Align partners, internal teams, and customer stakeholders around a shared deal strategy with no formal power over most parties 

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and building structure where none exists: Complex deals require inventing new playbooks 

  • Single point of accountability mindset: Own deal outcome completely; solve problems rather than escalate blame 

Preferred 

  • Experience originating transformational opportunities proactively, not just advancing inherited deals 

  • Familiarity with platform-based enterprise selling, cross-business-unit deal development, or ecosystem partnerships 

  • Experience with Office of CEO, Strategic Initiatives, or similar portfolio management 

  • Track record of building and mentoring teams, codifying playbooks, and raising capability standards across an organization

Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs. Compensation is based on the geographic location in which the role is located and is subject to change based on work location.

Job Description

ServiceNow is seeking a Partner Technology Architect to serve as the primary strategic interface for our Global and Strategic Regional partners. In this role, you will drive holistic partner growth through pre-sales technical excellence, business development, solution strategy, and AI-first technology adoption. You will combine trusted advisory relationships with partner executives, industry-aligned solution architecture, and go-to-market leadership into a single accountable role — translating platform capabilities, AI innovation, and industry context into repeatable, outcome-driven offerings that partners can build, scale, and monetize.

While this role expands into strategic business development and co-innovation, pre-sales technical excellence remains the primary operational foundation — including technical discovery, solution demonstrations, proof-of-concept leadership, and architectural validation that accelerates partner-led customer engagements.

What You’ll Do

As a Partner Technology Architect, you will serve as the dedicated strategic counterpart for assigned partner organizations, owning the full spectrum from pre-sales technical engagement through strategic co-innovation and business growth advisory.

Partner Strategy & Business Development

  • Serve as the primary strategic interface for assigned partners, building trusted relationships with partner executives and practice leaders.
  • Lead joint business planning to align partner investments, industry focus, and go-to-market priorities across all routes to market.
  • Advise partners on practice growth, specialization strategy, and readiness for AI-enabled offerings.
  • Influence partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline through offer-led strategy and solution differentiation.

Pre-Sales Excellence & Solution Strategy

  • Lead and support technical discovery sessions, executive briefings, and solution demonstrations that articulate platform value and accelerate partner-led deal velocity.
  • Drive solution strategy, helping partners align offerings to high-value industry workflows and customer outcomes.
  • Translate platform and AI capabilities into partner-differentiated, scalable solutions at the conceptual and architectural level.
  • Maintain strong workflow fluency across enterprise domains including CRM, IT, Security, and Business Services.
  • Design and execute partner-led proofs of concept and co-demonstrations that prove business value, technical feasibility, and competitive differentiation.
  • Provide technical escalation support for critical partner-led opportunities, ensuring partners have access to deep expertise at key deal milestones.

AI-First Innovation & Co-Creation

  • Champion AI-first solution design, including intelligent workflows, automation, and agent-based use cases.
  • Orchestrate partner engagement with Partner Solution Architects and domain-specialist advisors (AI, CRM, Security & Risk) to accelerate solution development.
  • Ensure partner offerings progress from concept through validation to scalable commercialization.
  • Promote responsible, enterprise-ready AI adoption aligned to governance and trust standards.

Value Engineering & Orchestration

  • Connect solution strategy to measurable business outcomes including efficiency, growth, ROI, and time-to-value.
  • Support executive-level conversations with clear value narratives and outcome-based storytelling.
  • Coordinate across internal specialist teams to deliver a unified partner experience, not fragmented touchpoints.

Qualifications

What you need to be successful in this role:

  • 8+ years of experience in pre-sales solution consulting, partner strategy, enterprise technology advisory, or related roles with proven success leading technical discovery, demonstrations, and partner engagements.
  • Proven experience working directly with partners, system integrators, hyperscalers, or technology alliances.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to influence senior partner stakeholders at VP+ level.
  • Demonstrated ability to connect business strategy, industry context, and technology solutions into actionable partner growth plans.
  • Experience shaping or scaling partner practices, offerings, or go-to-market motions.
  • Solid understanding of enterprise platforms and workflow-based solutions at the conceptual and architectural level.
  • Working knowledge of AI-enabled use cases, automation patterns, and data-driven workflows.
  • Deep familiarity with at least one industry vertical (e.g., Financial Services, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Public Sector).
  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving.

Preferred & Standout Experience:

  • Experience with ServiceNow platform and AI capabilities (Now Assist, AI Agents).
  • Background in management consulting, strategy advisory, or partner business development.
  • ServiceNow certifications (e.g., CSA, CIS, or architectural certifications).
  • Experience across multiple partner routes to market (C&I, MSP, Reseller, Hyperscaler, Build).
  • Familiarity with competitive platforms and ability to articulate ServiceNow differentiation.

What This Role Does Not Do

  • Perform platform configuration, development, or solution delivery.
  • Manage commercial contracts, pricing, or financial program management.
  • Replace deep technical or implementation specialist roles (leverages domain-specialist advisors and Partner Solution Architects for depth).
  • Own day-to-day partner relationship management (coordinates with Partner Management).

data.description:
Vice President of Commercial Operations

BusPatrol is seeking a high skilled Vice President of Commercial Operations. The VP, Commercial Operations will lead BusPatrol’s Sales Enablement and RFP functions, building the operating discipline, tools, content, training, and cross-functional coordination required to scale a complex B2G commercial motion. This leader will improve seller readiness and execution and professionalizing BusPatrol's RFP engine through clear standard work, stronger workflows, quality controls, and responsible AI adoption. The role will connect Sales, RevOps, Marketing, Policy/Government Relations, Legal, Product, and Post-Sales around a consistent, measurable go-to-market system.

Responsibilities:

  1. Own the Sales Enablement strategy and operating model. Establish the function’s mandate, roadmap, governance, intake and prioritization process, decision rights, service levels, and annual/quarterly operating cadence in alignment with the company’s commercial strategy.

  1. Build the training and development architecture. Lead onboarding, continuous training, manager coaching, launch support, certification, and field reinforcement programs that improve execution in BusPatrol’s complex, multi-stakeholder B2G sales environment.

  1. Drive sales methodology adoption and field performance. Embed consistent sales processes, stage expectations, management routines, and practical reinforcement mechanisms that improve execution, deal progression, and seller effectiveness.

  1. Create and govern the commercial content and tools system. Ensure that playbooks, stage guidance, talk tracks, battlecards, account-planning tools, stakeholder maps, state/policy guidance, CRM resources, and other field assets are practical, current, reusable, and accessible through a governed source of truth.

  1. Orchestrate cross-functional GTM alignment and field feedback. Connect Sales, RevOps, Marketing, Policy/Government Relations, Legal, RFP, Product, and Post-Sales so that commercial insights, process changes, market developments, and frontline feedback are translated into coordinated enablement priorities and field support.

  1. Establish and operate a commercial deal desk. Shepherd the last mile of contract execution by coordinating Sales, Legal, Finance, implementation, and installation; resolving deal-execution issues; ensuring commercial and operational readiness; and creating a smooth handoff from closed-won opportunity through delivery

  1. Lead and professionalize the RFP team. Improve the quality, consistency, speed, and predictability of RFP responses through standard work, clear workflows, reusable content, response templates, content governance, effective SME coordination, quality controls, and disciplined submission management—while maintaining the team’s core mandate and operating model.

  1. Build competitive intelligence capability. Establish repeatable processes for competitive snapshots, account briefs, stakeholder maps, opportunity watchlists, and field-ready competitive guidance that help teams understand market dynamics, competitive posture, and account context.

  1. Measure impact and drive continuous improvement. Define and manage performance measures across enablement and RFP operations, including adoption, ramp, manager usage, process adherence, stage conversion, pipeline quality, win-rate contribution, forecast confidence, RFP cycle time, response quality, reuse, and productivity.

Qualifications:

  • 12+ years of progressive experience across sales enablement, commercial operations, sales leadership, Marketing, proposal/RFP operations, or a closely related function

  • Demonstrated success building and scaling an enablement operating model, including sales rep onboarding, sales manager enablement, methodology adoption, content governance, certification, field reinforcement, and content performance measurement

  • Fluency with Salesforce and commercial performance data, including pipeline hygiene, stage progression, KPI design, dashboards, and translating analysis into targeted interventions

  • Experience using AI and knowledge-management tools to improve research, competitive intelligence, content creation, retrieval, standardization, reuse, and productivity

  • Executive-level communication and facilitation skills, with a track record of converting ambiguity into clear priorities, owners, operating rhythms, and measurable outcomes

  • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent graduate degree preferred (or equivalent practical experience)

At BusPatrol, safety isn’t just a priority — it’s our mission. As the nation’s most trusted school bus stop-arm technology solution, we serve over 350 school districts, protecting nearly 2 million students across 30,000 buses. Every day, millions of children rely on school buses to get to and from school safely, yet reckless drivers continue to put them at risk.

As a technology company with a unique focus on public safety, we use cutting-edge AI, machine learning, and telematics to improve school bus safety. Our all-in-one safety program equips school bus fleets with AI-powered cameras, cloud-based data management, and an integrated software platform to capture and process stop-arm violations. Our safety programs foster accountability and reduce dangerous driving behavior in communities across the country.

By partnering with school districts, municipalities, and law enforcement, we make safety solutions more accessible and effective, ensuring that every child’s journey to and from school is as safe as possible.

✔ The occasion to participate in BusPatrol’s culture of safety, learning, and teamwork

Be Part of Something Bigger

We are looking for a passionate and dedicated team member to help us make roads safer. This is a meaningful opportunity to contribute to a mission-driven company that is using technology to create real change. At BusPatrol, we foster an inclusive and diverse environment built on integrity, collaboration, and innovation. If you are ready to be part of a team that is deeply committed to safety and community impact, we would love to hear from you.

Together, we can protect students, hold drivers accountable, and build a safer future for all.

We are looking for a valued member of the BusPatrol team to assist us in our quest to improve children’s safety. This is an important role for us and a great opportunity for the right candidate. Our environment is inclusive, diverse, ignited, built on integrity, and deeply committed.

Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


Make Replit the single place where businesses can buy everything they need through their agents. As a Staff Software Engineer on Replit’s Money team, you’ll set technical direction and build the commerce platform that lets users discover, evaluate, purchase, and manage the products and services they need to build and run their businesses—without leaving Replit.

Replit already enables businesses to accept payments through integrations such as Stripe. This role builds on that foundation to expand what businesses can buy and accomplish through Replit Agent. You’ll design commerce experiences that combine the simplicity consumers expect with the controls enterprises need, making agent-assisted purchasing useful, trustworthy, and reliable.

You’ll own architecture and lead cross-team delivery across merchant and service-provider integrations, agent tools, purchasing workflows, and the lifecycle after a transaction. The challenge goes beyond executing a payment: agents need to understand what a user wants, present clear choices and costs, act within delegated authority, and verify that the purchase delivered the intended outcome. You’ll stay hands-on with design and code while aligning partners, mentoring engineers, and turning an ambitious product vision into incremental customer value.

Set the architecture and technical roadmap for agentic commerce, making Replit a single place to discover, buy, and manage the products and services businesses need.

You will:

  • Lead end-to-end purchasing experiences through Replit Agent: translate user intent into relevant options, communicate prices and terms, obtain appropriate authorization, execute purchases, and confirm fulfillment or provisioning.

  • Design agent-facing APIs and tools with clear contracts, secure credentials, scoped permissions, spending limits, and appropriate confirmation for consequential actions.

  • Partner with product and security to support enterprise purchasing requirements such as role-based access, approval workflows, purchasing policies, and auditable transaction histories, while keeping simpler purchases easy.

  • A security-conscious approach to authentication, authorization, credentials, sensitive data, and actions performed on a user’s or organization’s behalf.

data.description:
At Arctic Wolf, you won’t just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve – you'll help lead the change. Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We’re proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Gartner Peer Insights and IDC MarketScape – but what matters most is the work behind it: delivering real outcomes for customers through award winning innovation like our Aurora Platform.


If you’re looking for meaningful work, smart teammates and the chance to make a real impact in a high-growth company that’s redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you.


Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We’re looking for a Director, Marketing Technology & Campaign Operations to be a part of making this happen.


About the Role

The Director, Marketing Technology & Campaign Operations owns the technology, data, and operational engine that powers Arctic Wolf’s global marketing organization — from the marketing technology (MarTech) stack and artificial intelligence (AI) roadmap through the campaign operations execution that turns strategy into delivered programs. This role sits on the Growth Services and Operations leadership team and reports directly to the VP, Growth Services and Operations.


This leader owns the marketing technology ecosystem end to end, including Marketo administration, the broader go-to-market (GTM) technology stack, data architecture and governance, and the effort to embed AI into the team’s core workflows. The role also owns the operational engine that delivers campaigns on behalf of the teams that own strategy and pipeline targets, including Acquisition Marketing, Partner Marketing, Customer Marketing, and demand generation. This is a services and execution role for campaigns — it exists so the teams setting demand strategy have one reliable partner who builds, launches, and runs their programs to a high standard, on time, and within budget. Account-based marketing, pipeline acceleration and reengagement, and creative campaign programs sit outside this role's scope and remain owned by other teams.


This leader owns campaign execution across email, webinar, direct mail, and content syndication across the NAM (North America), EMEA (Europe, the Middle East, and Africa), and APAC (Asia-Pacific) regions and Arctic Wolf’s sales plays, including the intake model, service level agreements (SLAs), build and QA standards, and the budget and MDF (market development funds) administration that keep the broader marketing organization moving without becoming a bottleneck.


This is a people-leadership-heavy role, managing a distributed team that spans marketing technology, database management, email and nurture strategy, and campaign operations, and a close partner to the Senior Director, Campaigns and Content and the teams that own demand and pipeline targets.


Responsibilities


Marketing Technology Strategy & Architecture

  • Own the strategy, architecture, and performance of the marketing technology ecosystem, including Marketo administration, governance, and configuration.
  • Build and maintain a rolling 12- to 18-month technology roadmap aligned to company growth goals and GTM strategy.
  • Own vendor selection, contract negotiation, and renewal decisions for MarTech tools, including intent and enrichment platforms, AI data layers, and integration platform as a service (iPaaS) tools.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging technologies and vendors and recommend the highest-return investments.
  • Set up, manage, and troubleshoot integrations across the stack, including with Salesforce and other core business systems.

Embedding AI Into Marketing Operations

  • Lead the strategy and execution for embedding AI into the marketing technology stack and daily team workflows.
  • Identify and operationalize AI use cases that make marketers and sales development representatives (SDRs) more effective and efficient.
  • Own measurable outcomes tied to AI adoption, including cycle-time reduction and process automation, and report progress to leadership.
  • Stay ahead of MarTech and AI trends to keep Arctic Wolf’s stack modern and competitive.

Data, Lifecycle & Reporting Infrastructure

  • Own database strategy, lifecycle-stage design, lead scoring, and routing architecture in partnership with the marketing technology and database management team.
  • Own the data and reporting infrastructure that supports campaign attribution, sales-play performance, and pipeline reporting.
  • Establish data governance and compliance practices (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) that maintain accuracy and consistency across marketing systems.
  • Ensure the technology stack is configured for scale, security, compliance, and operational excellence.

Campaign Operations Leadership & Execution Excellence

  • Own the end-to-end campaign operations model across email, webinar (ON24), direct mail (Sendoso), content syndication, and list management, in partnership with the Campaigns and Content team.
  • Own the intake model, SLAs, prioritization, and operating cadence that campaign requests move through, including email rules of engagement.
  • Ensure consistent build quality, tracking, and attribution setup in Marketo and Salesforce across the NAM, EMEA, and APAC regions and sales plays.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to standardize and automate recurring campaign work.

Marketing Investment Planning & Budget Governance

  • Partner with the Revenue and Growth Leadership Team to develop the annual marketing budget, aligning spend with strategic growth priorities and pipeline targets.
  • Implement processes and controls to track, approve, and reconcile spend, ensuring budget discipline, transparency, and alignment with corporate finance practices.
  • Own budget and MDF administration for the team, including AWS Partner Funding requests, claims, and invoicing.

People Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead and develop a distributed team spanning marketing technology, database management, email and nurture strategy, and campaign operations.
  • Set clear priorities, SLAs, operating rhythms, and development plans, including a generalist coverage model so aligned stakeholders never lose a point of contact.
  • Build a culture of technical rigor, execution excellence, and continuous improvement.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Serve as the primary execution partner to Acquisition Marketing, Partner Marketing, Customer Marketing, and demand generation for their campaign programs.
  • Serve as the primary marketing partner to Business Applications and IT, resolving dependencies on routing, scoring, and lifecycle triggers.
  • Partner with the Senior Director, Campaigns and Content on campaign calendar, briefs, and content activation.
  • Partner with Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, and Finance on shared infrastructure, budget, and vendor decisions.
  • Represent marketing technology and campaign operations priorities in Growth Services and Operations leadership planning.

Who You Are​

  • You are a hands-on technical leader who understands marketing technology architecture at a deep level, and you can run a high-volume campaign execution engine at the same time.
  • You see AI as a practical tool for reducing manual work, not a buzzword, and you can identify where it will actually move the needle.
  • You build scalable processes, SLAs, and governance rather than absorbing chaos into your own schedule.
  • You can manage a distributed, regionally diverse team across both technology and execution disciplines and keep them focused on outcomes, not just tickets.
  • You don’t need to own the pipeline number to care about it — you measure yourself by how well you deliver for the teams who do.
  • You are comfortable owning a roadmap, a budget, and a vendor negotiation, and just as comfortable being hands-on in the platform or the campaign build when needed.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in marketing technology, marketing operations, campaign operations, or demand generation, including 3+ years of people leadership.
  • Hands-on experience with Marketo (or a comparable marketing automation platform) administration and Salesforce.
  • Experience building and owning a marketing technology roadmap, including vendor evaluation, integration management, and stack governance.
  • Experience managing multi-channel campaign execution, such as email, webinar, and direct mail, at scale.
  • Experience identifying and operationalizing AI or automation use cases within marketing or revenue operations workflows.
  • Experience managing distributed or global teams.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to connect marketing technology and campaign investments to revenue outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in cybersecurity, software as a service (SaaS), or another complex business-to-business (B2B) industry.
  • Experience managing a team spanning multiple regions, such as NAM, EMEA, and APAC.
  • Marketo certification or an equivalent platform certification.
  • Experience with intent or data enrichment tooling, such as 6sense, ZoomInfo, or Clay.
  • Experience administering a marketing budget or MDF program.

Travel Requirements

Typically 10% or less of business travel.


On-Camera Policy

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. Success is measured in more qualified pipeline per rep, faster deal cycles, and reps who no longer do the manual version of this work. Primary responsibilities include:

  • Automate prospecting by building agents that research accounts, build lists, and draft personalized outreach at scale for SDRs.
  • Build sequencing intelligence, designing workflows that optimize send times, cadence steps, and messaging based on engagement data.
  • Surface deal signals by building agents that mine call recordings and CRM activity for risk flags, buying signals, and next-best-action recommendations for AEs.
  • Own the outbound stack, integrating sales engagement, conversation intelligence, enrichment, and CRM so rep-facing data stays accurate and actionable, for example Outreach/Salesloft, Gong/Chorus, Salesforce, and ZoomInfo/Clearbit.
  • Support forecasting and pipeline hygiene by building automations that flag stale deals, missing data, and forecast risk before they become surprises.
  • Make quality measurable by building evals for outreach personalization quality, call-summary accuracy, and signal precision against human baselines.
  • Build the guardrails, implementing human-in-the-loop review for anything rep- or customer-facing, plus logging and rollback paths.
  • Coach and document, bringing SDRs, AEs, and revenue operations up the AI curve and building playbooks and reusable templates.
  • Ramp through a staged first year: in months 1 to 3, embed with one or two priority teams, map the current outbound motion end-to-end across prospecting, sequencing, call review, and deal progression, and ship your first prospecting or sequencing automation with an eval harness behind it; in months 4 to 6, deploy a deal-signal or call-intelligence agent live for AEs and stand up shared templates for outreach, personalization, and account research.
  • In months 7 to 12, own a meaningful slice of the outbound automation layer, show measurable gains in pipeline per rep, cycle time, and forecast accuracy, and hand off matured systems to SDR and AE leadership so they run day-to-day on the systems you built and instrumented.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • 6 or more years across sales development, sales operations, revenue operations, or systems/solutions engineering, with hands-on time building automation or AI into outbound or sales workflows.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, building, and deploying AI agents (prospecting agents, call-summary agents, deal-signal agents) that changed real pipeline or cycle-time outcomes.
  • Fluency with the outbound stack and how rep-facing data moves through it, including sales engagement platforms such as Outreach and Salesloft; conversation intelligence such as Gong and Chorus; CRM in Salesforce; forecasting in Clari; enrichment and prospecting through ZoomInfo, Clearbit, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator; and meeting scheduling through Chili Piper.
  • Strong prompt architecture skills and practical experience with agent frameworks, orchestration platforms such as n8n and Make, and API/MCP integrations.
  • Working proficiency in at least one of SQL, Python, or JavaScript, enough to build lightweight tools, integrations, and workflows.
  • A builder's instinct paired with GTM judgment: you understand quota, pipeline coverage, and deal stages, and you prioritize by revenue impact.
  • Experience building evaluation frameworks for AI systems (prompt evals, benchmarking, regression testing), and practical experience fine-tuning or heavily customizing models for production use cases, is preferred.
  • Familiarity with forecasting methodologies and pipeline hygiene practices is preferred.
  • Comfort coaching non-technical teammates through AI adoption and anticipating resistance without relying on positional authority is preferred.
  • A B2B or enterprise SaaS background, including familiarity with brand-safety and compliance constraints on automated outputs, is preferred.

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

As a Solutions Architect, Enterprise, you will be the technical lead for a portfolio of large customers evaluating, adopting and expanding Nebius AI Cloud. You will connect each customer's AI strategy and business priorities to a secure, scalable architecture, then guide the customer from technical discovery through technical scoping and production adoption.

This role sits at the intersection of cloud architecture, AI infrastructure and business value. You will work with Enterprise sales leaders and engage executives, platform teams, infrastructure leaders, security stakeholders and AI or machine learning practitioners. The strongest candidates combine hands-on technical depth with the judgment to navigate complex decisions of large organizations in real economic sectors.

You’re welcome to work remotely from the USA.

  • Serve as the trusted technical advisor for Enterprise accounts throughout evaluation, onboarding, adoption and expansion.
  • Lead technical discovery with business and technology stakeholders, clarify success criteria and translate requirements into practical AI cloud architectures.

data.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

About the role:

Join our Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team and help ensure the reliability, scalability, and performance of Replit's infrastructure that serves millions of developers worldwide. As a Staff Site Reliability Engineer, you will bridge the gap between development and operations, implementing automation and establishing best practices that enable our platform to scale efficiently while maintaining high availability.

We are seeking Staff SREs who are passionate about building and maintaining resilient systems at scale. Your mission will be to proactively find and analyze reliability problems across our stack, then design and implement software and systems to create step-function improvements. You will design robust observability solutions, lead incident response, automate operational tasks, and continuously improve our infrastructure's reliability, all while mentoring and educating the broader engineering team to make reliability a core value at Replit.

You Will:

  • Architect and Implement Observability: Design, build, and lead the implementation of comprehensive monitoring, logging, and tracing solutions. Create dashboards and metrics that provide real-time visibility into system health and performance, enabling proactive issue detection.

  • Define and Drive Reliability Standards: Work with product and engineering teams to define, implement, and track Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and Service Level Indicators (SLIs). Build systems to monitor and report on these metrics, holding teams accountable and ensuring we maintain high reliability standards while balancing innovation speed.

  • Lead Incident Management and Response: Act as a senior leader during high-impact incidents, guiding the team to rapid resolution. Conduct thorough, blameless post-mortems and drive the implementation of preventative measures. Develop and refine runbooks and build automation to reduce Mean Time To Recovery (MTTR).

  • Drive Automation and Infrastructure as Code: Architect, build, and improve automation to eliminate toil and operational work. Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation using tools like Terraform or Pulumi. Create self-healing systems that can automatically respond to common failure scenarios.

  • Optimize Performance on Kubernetes: Collaborate with core infrastructure and product teams to performance-tune and optimize our large-scale cloud deployments, with a deep focus on Kubernetes, Docker, and GCP. Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, implement capacity planning strategies, and reduce latency across global regions.

  • Debug and Harden Distributed Systems: Dive deep into debugging extremely difficult technical problems across the stack. Use your findings to design and implement long-term fixes that make our systems and products more robust, operable, and easier to diagnose.

  • Provide Staff-Level Guidance: Review feature and system designs from across the company, acting as a key owner for the reliability, scalability, security, and operational integrity of those designs.

  • Educate and Mentor: Educate, mentor, and hold accountable the broader engineering team to improve the reliability of our systems, making reliability a core value of the Replit engineering culture.

  • Build and Integrate: Write high-quality, well-tested code in Python or Go to meet the needs of your customers, whether it's building new internal tools or integrating with third-party vendors.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 8-10 years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering or similar roles (e.g., DevOps, Systems Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering).

  • Strong programming skills in languages like Python or Go. You write high-quality, well-tested code.

  • Deep understanding of distributed systems. You’ve designed, built, scaled, and maintained production services and know how to compose a service-oriented architecture.

  • Deep experience with container orchestration platforms, specifically Kubernetes, and cloud-native technologies.

  • Proven track record of designing, implementing, and maintaining sophisticated monitoring and observability solutions (e.g., metrics, logging, tracing).

  • Strong incident management skills with extensive experience leading incident response for complex systems and demonstrated critical thinking under pressure.

  • Experience with infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform, Pulumi) and configuration management tools.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly and simply and a bias toward open, transparent cultural practices.

  • Strong interpersonal skills, with experience working with and mentoring engineers from junior to principal levels.

  • A willingness to dive into understanding, debugging, and improving any layer of the stack.

  • You're passionate about making software creation accessible and empowering the next generation of builders.

Bonus Points:

  • Deep experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services and tools.

  • Expert-level knowledge of modern observability platforms (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry).

  • Experience designing and building reliable systems capable of handling high throughput and low latency.

  • Significant experience with Go and Terraform.

  • Familiarity with working in rapid-growth, startup environments.

  • Experience writing company-facing blog posts and training materials.
